commands.path: start recording apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the start recording reverse-ETL action
examples: pm 100ms start recording apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: starts a composite recording job for the named room; consumes recording/storage quota. External mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: stop recording apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the stop recording reverse-ETL action
examples: pm 100ms stop recording apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: stops all recording jobs currently running in the named room; external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: templates list
examples: pm 100ms templates list --json

commands.path: update room apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the update room reverse-ETL action
examples: pm 100ms update room apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing room's metadata, or disables/re-enables it via the enabled field (100ms's disable/enable API is the same POST /rooms/{id} endpoint); disabling blocks all future joins to that room. External mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: update room code apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the update room code reverse-ETL action
examples: pm 100ms update room code apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: enables or disables a specific join-credential room code; disabling revokes that code's ability to join. External mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
